notes: NHRA = nhra_mustang-1969-1993.json. NHRA rows under TORINO GT / COBRA / MONTEGO GT / ESCORT GT and the 1971/1973 'GT' headings (Torino/Montego/Maverick engines, e.g. 170/100, 400/168, 429/201) are sister models and were ignored; NHRA is never listed in 'sources'. Wikipedia articles count as one source. Two editions of the same year's Ford brochure count as one source; the two Ford 'Mustang Facts' releases and the Ford timeline sheet count as one Ford source. HP: gross through 1971, SAE net from 1972. Status rule: confirmed = NHRA + at least 2 independent sources for the engine, hp matched by at least one independent source; disputed = engine confirmed but the rating splits with no factory tie-breaker (or availability itself conflicts) - alternatives in hp_alternatives/note. Ford brochures 1972-1983 print no hp, so net ratings for those years rest on NHRA + The Mustang Source + MustangSpecs + Wikipedia; MustangSpecs' tables have many errors (wrong-year figures, Windsor/Cleveland labels) and were never used alone. HowStuffWorks/Consumer Guide, Hemmings, MotorTrend were unreachable.
